visualization.title: Drugs given together in the same arm: Pembrolizumab · Non-small cell lung cancer

answer_summary: The drugs most often given in the same arm as Pembrolizumab are Carboplatin (116 trials), Pemetrexed (105 trials), Cisplatin (65 trials), Paclitaxel (56 trials), Nab-paclitaxel (34 trials); 348 different drugs appear with it in total. Based on 608 trials from ClinicalTrials.gov.
